newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Hundreds of Kazakh miners fired for drinking binge.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of Kazakh miners fired for drinking binge.

text.p: About 300 miners have been sacked for going on a drunken binge to celebrate the New Year before they were due on night shift at a copper mine in Kazakhstan, an official newspaper said on Tuesday.
The miners either arrived for their shift very drunk or did not turn up for work at all, said the Kazakhstanskaya Pravda daily.
They were given the sobering news that they had been sacked after the New Year holidays, traditionally the biggest annual party in the former Soviet Union.
The paper noted drinking at Kazakh mines had cost the lives of six miners in 1996.
"Now it has been decided not to re-employ such workers...the more so that they do not only kill themselves but also damage costly imported equipment," it said.
